description: Deterministic, synthetic, privacy-safe behavior fixtures pinning CURRENT behavior. These are characterization fixtures: they record what the code does today, including the divergences. Where Python and Go disagree, the disagreement is kept visible.
principles: Synthetic: no real chat ids, no real tokens, no production data.
Deterministic: same input -> same output, no clock dependency except where noted.
Independent of live Telegram accounts and production database rows.
Reusable across Python and Go: every fixture names the engine and the expected output for each language.

fixtures.description: Regex block and regex require both configured - require-any semantics
fixtures.notes: rx_require is require-any: one matching pattern satisfies it.

fixtures.description: Invalid blocking regex fails CLOSED (drop, not crash)
fixtures.notes: services.py:138-145 logs [FILTER_ENGINE:INVALID_REGEX] and fails closed.

fixtures.description: Legacy regex_patterns with blacklist keywords acts as blocking
fixtures.notes: legacy list becomes rx_block only when blacklist set and whitelist empty (services.py:104-116, filter.go:172-181).

fixtures.description: Legacy regex_patterns with whitelist keywords acts as requirement
fixtures.notes: gold absent -> regex_mismatch, not whitelist_mismatch: order checks regex AFTER whitelist.

fixtures.description: Parked list (blacklist_off) is skipped by ContentPolicy; FilterRule has no such switch
fixtures.notes: blacklist_off lives on ContentPolicy (content_policy.py:855). FilterRule.evaluate has no equivalent - the two systems differ; this fixture pins that boundary.

fixtures.description: Persian keyword with Arabic Yeh folding
fixtures.input_note: text uses Persian ی (U+06CC) in تخفیف; needle uses Arabic ي (U+064A) in تخفيف. fold_text (content_policy.py:131) normalizes the variants.
fixtures.notes: fold_text at content_policy.py:131 normalizes Arabic/Persian letter variants; contains_word applies it.

fixtures.description: Whitelist phrase mode with double spaces/newlines between words
fixtures.notes: contains_word collapses whitespace variation before matching (content_policy.py:164).

fixtures.description: Whitelist all-mode: every word must be present
fixtures.notes: content_policy.py:856-865.

fixtures.description: Empty allow-list means allow-all, never deny-all
fixtures.notes: has_rules is false when lists are empty, so is_active short-circuits.

fixtures.description: Full cleaner order on one message
fixtures.notes: Cleaner order entities.py:2391-2405: urls -> mentions -> hashtags -> emojis -> phones -> unconditional [ \t]{2,} -> empty lines -> \n{3,}.

fixtures.description: Bare 10-digit product id is deliberately preserved
fixtures.notes: HIGH divergence F-07: Python _strip_phone_numbers requires a '+' or a separator inside; Go phoneRegex \+?\d[\d\s\-()]{7,18}\d eats the id. Divergence kept visible.

fixtures.description: Mention length bound divergence between cleaner and legacy/Go
fixtures.notes: Cleaner uses {4,64} (entities.py:101) so @abc survives; legacy services.py:27 and Go transform.go:28 use {3,32} so they strip it. F-07.

fixtures.description: Hashtag regex divergence on hyphenated tag
fixtures.notes: Cleaner #\w+ (entities.py:102) stops at the hyphen; Go #[^\s#@]+ (transform.go:24) consumes it. F-07.

fixtures.description: ZWJ family emoji leaves dangling joiners
fixtures.notes: F-03, verified by coordinator execution 2026-11-02: ZWJ (U+200D) is BMP and not matched, so family sequences are shredded.

fixtures.description: Keycap sequence leaves dangling U+20E3
fixtures.notes: F-03: 5 is BMP (kept), U+FE0F variation selector removed, U+20E3 combining keycap is BMP (kept).

fixtures.description: Non-emoji supplementary-plane script is destroyed (collateral damage)
fixtures.notes: F-03: [\U00010000-\U0010ffff] matches ALL non-BMP characters, not just emoji.

fixtures.description: Persian and Arabic text adjacent to emoji survives; double space left
fixtures.notes: Coordinator-verified. The regex does not touch Arabic/Persian; note the double space the removal leaves.

fixtures.description: Arrows and combining marks are NOT removed
fixtures.notes: U+2190 (arrow) and combining marks are outside every alternation. Pins that the pattern is too narrow AND too broad.

fixtures.description: Python len() and Go len() count differently once supplementary characters appear
fixtures.notes: len() in Python counts codepoints; Go len() counts bytes and 12 runes. Every length-bound setting (min/max_message_length, caption_max_length) must declare which unit it promises - Go filter.go uses byte len() today.

fixtures.description: Priority decides the # -> ## then ## -> x composition
fixtures.notes: Both default-priority so insertion order decides (stable sort, text_replace.py:435). Same-priority insertion order IS the observable contract; priority is the documented escape hatch.

fixtures.description: Exact-case pass happens first, case-insensitive only as fallback
fixtures.notes: text_replace.py:385-390: `DISCOUNT in text` is true so str.replace handles both occurrences exactly.

fixtures.description: Mixed case falls back to case-insensitive single pass
fixtures.notes: Exact form absent -> re.sub IGNORECASE replaces both.

fixtures.description: Empty replacement deletes the matched span
fixtures.notes: Trailing space is NOT stripped by the replace engine (downstream stages may).

fixtures.description: Regex entry uses backreferences; literal entry renders backslash literally
fixtures.notes: _literal_replacement (text_replace.py:402): regex entries pass the template through; literal entries escape backslashes so \1 renders as \1.

fixtures.description: Invalid regex entry is skipped, text unchanged, never raises
fixtures.notes: apply_entry catches re.error, logs [PIPELINE:REPLACE], returns text (text_replace.py:391-397).

fixtures.description: tg:// and ftp:// pass the FilterEngine gate but drop under has_link (F-14)
fixtures.notes: F-14, coordinator-verified by execution: URL_REGEX does not match tg://, _RE_LINK does.

fixtures.description: FilterEngine gate treats @mention as a link; has_link does not (F-14)
fixtures.notes: URL_REGEX contains @[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,32} as an alternation (services.py:25-30), _RE_LINK does not.

fixtures.description: Target override remove_links deletes usernames in Go but not in Python (F-13)
fixtures.notes: Python remove_urls keeps @mentions; Go urlRegex includes the mention alternation.

fixtures.description: remove_links=true silently ignores link_replacement on the durable path (F-04)
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:1438 if/elif: remove_links wins on the durable path; services.py:268-271 gives replacement precedence on the legacy path.

fixtures.description: Placeholders are NOT interpolated on the durable path (F-15)
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:1547 applies the header raw; HeaderFormatter runs only via transform_text (gRPC TestRule, edit-sync). The preview lies about production.

fixtures.description: One event to two targets: target override rejects only its own copy
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:1197-1214: only the target:-prefixed override is re-decided, on the transformed text; the other target still receives it.

fixtures.description: Source override adds a constraint; it cannot relax the task policy
fixtures.notes: Additive-only: both must allow (pipeline.py:974-1016).

fixtures.description: Media-only message: caption is the effective text
fixtures.notes: entities.py:2498-2502. This is why apply_to_caption=False cannot disable caption cleaning (F-09).

fixtures.description: Album consumes exactly one forward_every_n slot
fixtures.notes: The FEN gate runs after aggregation (pipeline.py:1036 is after album flush).

fixtures.description: Duplicate content with a different message id is dropped under the same rule
fixtures.notes: Fingerprint is rule-scoped body+media kind (pipeline.py:267), not message id.

fixtures.description: dedupe_policy has no runtime effect (F-01)
fixtures.expected: identical behavior to STRICT - column is STORED_BUT_UNUSED
fixtures.notes: Persisted by SQLite/Postgres/proto/backup, zero runtime consumers.

fixtures.description: N=1 is a byte-for-byte no-op (no row, no read)
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:1036-1084.

fixtures.description: A filtered message consumes no slot
fixtures.notes: F-05: the gate runs after every filter.

fixtures.description: Keyword match on source text schedules the reply as its own job
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:1298-1330. The reply is secondary/best-effort and never drops the forward.

fixtures.description: Registry bound (604800) and engine bound (31_536_000) disagree (F-17)
fixtures.notes: The registry clamps at write (max 604800); at execution get_auto_delete_seconds applies min(ttl, 31_536_000), so 2_000_000 survives. F-17.

fixtures.description: A paused rule stops before any transform runs
fixtures.notes: pipeline.py:789 is before the FILTER stage.

fixtures.description: Service message with no attached filter is dropped
fixtures.notes: services.py:61-66; filter.go:85-96.

fixtures.description: Duplicate header insertion is prevented
fixtures.notes: services.py:241-252: startswith check prevents re-prepending.
